dogecoin.text:
like a month later i checked my Doge wallet and i didnt understand what the number was on my screen, it was my account balance haha.

I had turned $350 into $10,000 in a few months, just from Bitcoin and Dogecoin.

In just a few weeks btc spiked and it turned into $1,500! 

So i got the crypto bug and heard about silly ol Dogecoin and had a funny feeling, so i put half my btc money in Doge at 5 cents.
